name: Meres
overview: Meres is a male figure identified as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media, a position of significant authority within the ancient empire. No specific tribal affiliation or additional notes are recorded about him in Scripture. His role highlights the structured governance under the Persian and Median rule during the period referenced.
namesAndTitles: The name Meres means 'worthy,' a proper name that does not appear to have been given directly by God. This meaning may reflect his esteemed status among the princes mentioned.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Meres beyond his designation as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media. There are no additional familial connections noted.
scriptureSignificance: Meres holds significance as a member of the elite governing body in the Persian and Median empire, indicating his involvement in the administration and political affairs of that time. His mention among the seven princes underscores the organized leadership structure that influenced the events recorded in the biblical narrative. Although details about his personal actions are limited, his position situates him within the broader context of God's providence over earthly kingdoms.
